gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-89.670723 39.765282)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

  FROM public.dem_us r, buffered_geom

),
ruggedness_index AS (
  SELECT ST_RuggednessIndex(clipped_rast) AS ruggedness
  FROM clipped_raster
)
SELECT ruggedness AS elevation_fluctuation_ruggedness_index
FROM ruggedness_index;
